newtons_cradle.intent: Newton's cradle: the raised left ball swings down and strikes the row; the right ball swings out and back, and the exchange repeats while the middle balls stay nearly still.

one_shot.issue: The left ball does not swing down into the row in the visible first motion. In the consecutive strip from 0.00s to 0.58s it moves further left and partially off-frame instead of descending toward the middle balls; by 0.58s it has vanished off the left edge while the row remains still.

loop_k2_b1_c2_r2.issue: The left raised ball does swing inward over the first half-second: in the consecutive strip it moves from far left at 0.00s toward the row by 0.58s, but it is still well short of contacting the row at 0.58s.

gears.intent: The two meshing gears turn in opposite directions; the small gear turns faster in proportion to its size, and the teeth stay meshed without passing through each other.

one_shot.issue: The gears do rotate in opposite directions, visible in the orientation marks from 0.00s to 0.58s and across the overview, but the tooth contact is not mechanically meshed: at the contact point around 0.58s, 1.17s, and 2.25s the teeth visually overlap or pass through one another instead of alternating tooth-to-gap contact.

loop_k2_b1_c2_r2.issue: The gears do rotate in opposite directions: the large gear's marker advances clockwise while the small gear's marker advances counterclockwise, and the small gear visibly turns faster, especially from 0.00s to 0.58s.

dominoes.intent: The ball rolls right into the first domino; the dominoes topple one after another in a chain, and the last one falls flat.

one_shot.issue: The ball does roll right in the first 0.58s, but it stops short of visibly striking the first domino; at 0.58s there is still a small gap, and by 1.17s the first domino has already fallen without a clear contact moment.

loop_k2_b1_c2_r2.issue: The ball does move right in the consecutive strip from 0.00s to 0.58s, but the actual impact with the first domino is not clearly shown; by 1.17s several dominoes are already falling while the ball appears only just at the start of the row.

cat_box.intent: The cat crouches, leaps in an arc onto the box, lands with a little squash, and sits on top.

one_shot.issue: The cat does crouch before takeoff: in the consecutive strip the body/head lower gradually from 0.33s to 0.58s, and the overview shows the crouch at 0.58s.

loop_k2_b1_c2_r2.issue: The crouch/anticipation is very weak: from 0.00s to 0.50s in the consecutive strip the cat barely lowers or compresses before takeoff, so the leap feels under-prepared.

story.intent: A three-beat story: the cloud drifts over the sun and the scene dims, rain falls from the cloud, then the sprout grows taller and its bud opens into a flower.

one_shot.issue: At 1.75s through 6.00s the cloud reaches the sun area and the scene dims, but the sun disk and rays remain visibly drawn on top of/through the cloud, so the cloud does not convincingly pass over and occlude the sun.

loop_k2_b1_c2_r2.issue: No rain is visible at any sampled time; the cloud covers the sun from about 1.75s onward, but there are no falling drops between the cloud and ground during the intended rain beat.
